name: Suspicious Execution Of Renamed Sysinternals Tools - Registry
description: Detects the creation of the "accepteula" key related to the Sysinternals tools being created from executables with the wrong name (e.g. a renamed Sysinternals tool)
author: GAI_CTI
query: (winlog.event_data.EventType:CreateKey AND (registry.path:(*\\Active\ Directory\ Explorer* OR *\\Handle* OR *\\LiveKd* OR *\\ProcDump* OR *\\Process\ Explorer* OR *\\PsExec* OR *\\PsLoggedon* OR *\\PsLoglist* OR *\\PsPasswd* OR *\\PsPing* OR *\\PsService* OR *\\SDelete*)) AND registry.path:*\\EulaAccepted) AND (NOT (process.executable:(*\\ADExplorer.exe OR *\\ADExplorer64.exe OR *\\handle.exe OR *\\handle64.exe OR *\\livekd.exe OR *\\livekd64.exe OR *\\procdump.exe OR *\\procdump64.exe OR *\\procexp.exe OR *\\procexp64.exe OR *\\PsExec.exe OR *\\PsExec64.exe OR *\\PsLoggedon.exe OR *\\PsLoggedon64.exe OR *\\psloglist.exe OR *\\psloglist64.exe OR *\\pspasswd.exe OR *\\pspasswd64.exe OR *\\PsPing.exe OR *\\PsPing64.exe OR *\\PsService.exe OR *\\PsService64.exe OR *\\sdelete.exe)))
